idMeaning: sourceControlIds are existing SVG layer IDs from the manifest, not Figma node IDs. Resolve them to imported Figma nodes by exact layer name. Never invent Figma node IDs.

actionMeaning.navigate: Switch top-level screen and clear any open overlay.
actionMeaning.open_overlay: Open target over its named base using captured position/dimensions.
actionMeaning.swap_overlay: Replace current overlay while preserving the same base; do not stack drawers.
actionMeaning.close_overlay: Dismiss overlay to its correct current base.
actionMeaning.prototype_handoff: Show a labelled external handoff example; no automatic external navigation.
actionMeaning.show_prepared_search_results: Prepared example query/result transition, with no claim of arbitrary text input.
actionMeaning.show_duplicate_schedule_notice: Show the actual rejection and route edits to My Plan; capture required.
actionMeaning.open_context_navigation: Use the menu appropriate for current account/setup state.

stateRules: Guest analysis remains account-free. Account gate and sign-in precede signed-in learning resources.
The unplanned starting state preserves the manual goal and saved Pandas course but has no pending plan, choices, selected schedule or events.
Only unplanned routine may import successfully; existing scheduled course frames are review/edit examples.
Pandas is already saved in the starting fixture. Save/remove requires separately captured unsaved/removed states; no silent count changes.
Current blank sign-in fields and current unselected Analytical thinking state require the explicit guards recorded on their edges.
Do not wire disabled controls or controls outside the captured visible area. Check layout-capture disabled/clip data before applying a link.
Controls absent from this plan remain unwired and should be disclosed in the review note.
Use native overlay crop coordinates and screen viewport heights from the manifest.
Future E7–E9 concepts must not appear as current main-flow destinations.
